purpose: Define the claim-discipline rules for any later textbook integration of the applied 046-049 sequence.

non_claims: Does not authorize textbook edits by itself.
Does not assert universal A/E slot occupancy.
Does not assert A/E slot symmetry.
Does not assert all RTs are projections.

claim_discipline_rules: Every new textbook sentence must preserve explicit provenance to applied governance sources.
Every projection claim must remain labeled provisional unless a later theorem patch promotes it.
Every A/E nesting note must preserve the role-asymmetry result and must not infer slot symmetry.
Every Core Expression projection note must preserve the distinction between the Core Expression and RT_core.
Every invariant claim must stay bounded by its witness and counterexample boundary.
Every mention of Chapter 6.4 must keep recovery semantics deferred.
Every mention of Chapter 14.8 must preserve the gate-before-edit order.
prohibited_language: identity of the Core Expression with RT_core

claim_classes.note: RT-governed primitives remain distinct from all RT-governed expressions.
The section remains a provenance-explicit partial section with recovery deferred.
Metric extraction stays a projection note, not a primitive identity claim.
Asymmetry remains structural, not inferred from metric symmetry.
Nested RT witness remains a witness, not a universal theorem.
Legality transform remains a governed projection transform.
Evidence integration workflow records the gate-before-edit rule.

required_disclaimers: This plan does not edit the textbook yet.
This plan does not change RT_core.
This plan does not elevate the applied 046-049 sequence to theorem status.
This plan does not claim universal A/E slot occupancy.
This plan does not claim role symmetry.
This plan does not claim all RTs are projections.
textbook_update_order: Add the controlled note or cross-reference second.
Keep any claim label provisional or governed.
